About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As a Product Manager for the Research team at Anthropic, you will own the ideation and deployment of new models and products as we advance frontier, safe AI technology. You will work closely with our research teams to help productize credible applied research and identify high-potential use cases grounded in customer needs.

We are looking for someone passionate about developing safe and beneficial artificial intelligence technologies. You thrive in ambiguous environments and can uncover latent, non-obvious use cases for nascent technologies, bringing these insights back to research.

Your curiosity about user needs enables you to connect advanced technology to products that deliver real-world value.
We seek experienced founders and product managers who can bridge research and ambitious product experimentation, with the ability to create and grow entirely new product categories enabled by AI.

Lead vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution of frontier technologies that leverage the latest AI capabilities to solve real-world problems
Partner with research to define, improve, and ship model capabilities within a research area
Identify nascent research that could become transformative products
Synthesize user insights into actionable requirements and evaluations
Understand the AI landscape and ecosystem, ensuring we have an objective view of market capabilities and our position
Work with and influence a diverse set of stakeholders, including research, product engineering, and platform engineering teams

Have a deep passion and curiosity for AI and LLMs. Use AI regularly.
Are a first-principles thinker with the ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, flexing into different domains based on the business problem at hand and finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions
Possess a deep technical background with a strong grasp of AI/ML concepts and are willing to go deep on technical solutions; have a data-driven mindset with working proficiency in Python and SQL
Have strong user empathy and the ability to synthesize vague or contradictory feedback into actionable priorities
Have a track record of launching ambitious products that have achieved distribution or commercial success
Have intellectual curiosity without ego—comfortable asking questions and learning independently
Think creatively about the risks and benefits of new technologies, moving beyond past checklists and playbooks
Have a creative, hacker spirit and love solving puzzles
Have 5+ years in product management, with experience launching new products and scaling existing ones (founder background is a plus)

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

This individual will help shape the next generation of our Tenancy-as-a-Service (TaaS) offering, transitioning Auth0 from a standard identity layer into the central orchestration plane and Directory of Tenancy for modern B2B SaaS, PaaS, and enterprise applications.

You will be responsible for defining our Organization lifecycle management features at scale, enabling Auth to be a true control plane for SaaS application onboarding and lifecycle management. Your domain will center heavily on tenant management features, enabling new functionality such as customizable schemas, entitlements, and feature flags.
In addition, you will partner with our ISV ecosystem team to deliver a clear perspective on how our SaaS ISVs ultimately enable their products to become discoverable and monetizable on top of the Auth0/Okta platforms.
In this role, you will not only be responsible for owning the vision, but for designing a roadmap that provides incremental value along the way, layering and ordering features based on market demand, and refining the product and strategy at each step.

You will focus on, and ultimately deliver delight to, our B2B admins and developers every step along the way. As a Group Product Manager at Okta, you will be supported by a dedicated product team to make your requirements a reality. We have a team of business agility, program, and product experts to ensure you have all the tools to be successful.

Do hands-on research and prototyping of identity and tenancy solutions and market tests for viability.
Deeply embed yourself in B2B software development, understand how multi-tenant SaaS is built, the common pain points, and be able to articulate challenges and opportunities in the space.
Own the product lifecycle for B2B mass management tooling, driving the strategy to simplify the management 100’s of thousands of B2B organizations
Architect the roadmap for schema-driven operations, introducing type-safe custom schemas and Structured Tenant Metadata explicitly tied to the Auth0 Organization container along with the change management of these custom schemas.
Work with our engineering and design team to build actionable requirements, APIs, and detailed specifications to enable engineering execution.
Build roadmaps and compelling business cases that articulate your product direction, financial strategy, and downstream alignment.
Follow our PDLC (Product Delivery Lifecycle) to drive a complete vision, while upholding the highest standards in security, architecture, and design.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. The Device Identity and Access team ensures that every endpoint interacting with corporate resources is trusted, healthy, and secure. Our pillar spans four domains: Device Identity, Device Authentication, Device Security Posture, and Endpoint AI Security.
We are hiring a Product Manager to drive our Zero Trust Authentication group. In this role, you will lead the core execution, performance, and deployment strategy for Okta’s foundational endpoint products. You will own the operational excellence of Okta Verify , FastPass , and Device Assurance , ensuring that our core passwordless authentication flows and device posture engines remain performant, secure, and incredibly easy for global enterprises to deploy at scale.
This is a critical, high-impact role designed for a highly autonomous product manager. You will take on the tactical execution and smaller strategic investments for our endpoint authenticators, acting as the team's operational anchor so that our senior product leaders can continuously expand our strategic frontiers.
What you will own
You will bridge user experience and deep systems engineering to ensure our core authentication products scale reliably for millions of global users.
Core Device Assurance Execution: Own the roadmap for our baseline security posture checks (such as OS version validation, disk encryption, and firewall status). You will manage the execution of our posture policy engine and our first-party EDR/MDM signal integrations.
Okta Verify Core Features: You will lead the feature roadmap and runtime capabilities for Okta Verify across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux. You will focus on transforming raw device-side signals into secure user experiences, managing the lifecycle of on-device authenticators, and shipping tactical feature enhancements.
Frictionless FastPass Adoption: You will drive the enrollment, registration, and adoption feature loops for FastPass, our premier passwordless, phishing-resistant authenticator. You will build zero-touch MDM provisioning paths, streamlined setup flows, and deployment controls that make passwordless authentication frictionless to activate.
A day in the life
Your day is a constant balancing act between core platform execution and immediate customer support. You might start your morning on a call with a strategic customer, taking tactical feedback on a Device Assurance integration and helping them design a phased rollout plan to migrate their users to FastPass. By midday, you are partnering with your engineering leads and software architects, debating the technical trade-offs of a client-side storage upgrade or reviewing app startup latency metrics.
By midday, you shift your focus to execution. You thrive on taking highly ambiguous problem spaces and bringing absolute clarity to the engineering teams. You partner deeply with your engineering leads and architects, debating technical trade-offs and ensuring that project requirements are clearly defined, scoped, and directly tied to delivering concrete solutions for our customers.
In the afternoon, you collaborate with your product peers to ensure that foundational device signals map cleanly to downstream capabilities like Identity Threat Protection or core policy evaluations. You write highly detailed, plain-prose specifications with clear problem statements to guide developer execution.

You close the day working with our Go-To-Market and support teams, ensuring they have the technical documentation and tooling needed to diagnose customer issues, resolve endpoint friction, and drive up FastPass activation rates.

Collaborate with engineering, design, and research teams to define and document user stories and technical use cases that guide product development for core endpoint features.
Define and execute the product roadmap, prioritizing technical debt, security hardening, and core platform enhancements alongside customer feature requests.
Engage customers to identify friction and technical pain points, use their feedback to inform our roadmap prioritization.
Define and communicate clear, technical requirements for the endpoint applications, ensuring engineering teams have unambiguous guidance for platform-level implementation.
Track industry trends in client operating systems, security compliance standards, and platform authenticators to ensure Okta’s foundational offerings remain highly competitive.
Be the subject matter expert for your product area and help enable your counterparts in the core product, Marketing, and tech partnerships teams.

BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical degree. Top 3 qualities we are hiring for
Founder-level ownership : You do not need an instruction manual, a playbook, or perfectly defined processes to do your job. You thrive in zero-to-one ambiguity, take absolute accountability for your domain's success or failure, and when in doubt, you bias toward action and decide.
Decisive action in the dark : You rarely have perfect data or complete requirements. You confidently make high-stakes calls using a mix of telemetry, customer anecdotes, and sharp product intuition. You explicitly name your assumptions, move fast, and revise them in public without ego when new information arrives.

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations, including the U.S. Department of War (DoW), its constituent services, and the broader U.S. National Security industry. The Product Manager, Public Sector will lead Scale's product efforts across two connected focus areas — military planning and real-time AI and Alerting (LUX) — shaping real production outcomes and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.
This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer.

This PM owns product outcomes for a cross-cutting portfolio of AI and data capabilities: earning deep trust with senior military, civilian, and mission stakeholders, driving deployments to production inside classified and operationally constrained environments, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to Scale's platform team.

The best candidates have shipped AI or real-time data products into defense or other large, security-constrained organizations and can tell the difference between a customer's stated request, their actual problem, and what the platform should do.

Own product outcomes across Scale's military planning portfolio and/or its highest-impact national security accounts for LUX, spanning multiple DoW and National Security stakeholders and use cases. You are the accountable PM for product delivery and customer value.
Translate operational reality into high-signal product input for engineering and platform teams — specific, evidence-backed product perspective with tradeoffs articulated, not requirements docs. This includes military planning workflows (e.g., the Joint Planning Process) and modeling/simulation requirements (e.g., AFSIM), as well as real customer workflows, latency/throughput constraints, and mission priorities for LUX.
Build trusted advisory relationships with senior military leaders (flag/general officer and senior civilian equivalents), National Security customer stakeholders, and senior technical leads. Become the reliable escalation point on the Scale side before issues surface externally.
Drive deployments from contract to production inside classified and operationally constrained environments — whether that means military planning workflows or LUX's low-latency, high-throughput, mission-critical data systems. You know what "production-ready" means inside DoW, and you close the gap.
Distinguish where the product is the constraint from where execution, integration, policy, or change management is the constraint. Drive each type of blocker to resolution through the right channel.
Shape a cross-cutting set of solutions spanning multiple stakeholders, echelons, and use cases, rather than owning a single point deployment.
Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) teams and Platform Capability teams so the account runs as a coordinated team, not a set of parallel workstreams.
Identify and develop expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value.
Represent customer reality to the platform and leadership with enough credibility that it changes decisions.
Balance competing requirements across CCMDs and service components that must collaborate despite differing needs — distinct from building for a single customer.
Travel as required to customer sites, including classified facilities.

Enterprise deployment ownership : has driven AI/ML or complex/real-time software products from contract to production at scale — including near-zero-to-one, with no real users yet — with real integration, real security constraints, and real change management.
Domain fluency : working knowledge of the military planning process and modeling/simulation tools (e.g., Joint Planning Process, AFSIM), and/or the tradeoffs inherent to real-time, event-driven, high-throughput data architectures and their implications for AI agents — and how each shapes product decisions.
Product judgment in the field : translates customer reality into product direction, not just feature requests; can say no credibly and explain why.
Customer trust-building : earns and maintains trust with demanding senior military, civilian, and mission stakeholders over multi-quarter engagements; manages conflict without eroding the relationship.
Technical translation : bridges the gap between customer engineering/planning teams and Scale platform engineers; adds interpretation rather than simply relaying messages.
Operating in ambiguity and constrained environments : creates structure where there is none; makes decisions with incomplete information inside classified settings; does not wait for fully defined requirements.
Clear, precise communication : adjusts for audience (senior leader vs. engineer vs. PM); writes and speaks at the right level of detail; does not over- or under-explain.

Active TOP SECRET security clearance (TS/SCI eligibility preferred).
6+ years in product management, technical program management, or a customer-facing product ownership role, including experience operating at an L6 (senior/staff) level of scope and autonomy.
Direct experience working with the U.S. Department of War (DoW) or the broader U.S. national security community.
Working knowledge of at least one of the following, with an ability to speak credibly to the other:
The military planning process (e.g., the Joint Planning Process) and modeling/simulation systems (e.g., AFSIM).
Real-time streaming data systems — event-driven architectures, low-latency pipelines, and high-throughput data processing — and how they behave in production.
Demonstrated record of shipping AI or data products into large, constrained, classified, or highly regulated organizations — not pilots or proofs-of-concept. You can name the customer, the scale, the integration, and what production actually looked like.
Extreme ownership and follow-through: closes loops without reminders, drives outcomes across teams without formal authority, holds self and others to commitments.
Comfortable operating with senior military/civilian/mission stakeholders and senior engineers simultaneously; credible presence in high-stakes rooms on both sides.
Strong judgment under pressure: makes good calls quickly with incomplete information, knows when to escalate vs. resolve, does not generate thrash.
Technical fluency sufficient to hold a real conversation with a platform engineer about architectural tradeoffs — not deep coding, but genuine comprehension of how systems work in production.
Ability to shape a cross-cutting set of solutions across multiple stakeholders and use cases, rather than customer-specific solutions.

Direct experience with AI/ML platform products — agentic capabilities, human-agent interaction, large-scale data, some T&E; or data labeling, RLHF, fine-tuning workflows, and model evaluation pipelines.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the Product - Connect Platform
Connect is Stripe’s platform for businesses that serve other businesses. It gives platforms the infrastructure to represent the people and companies in their ecosystem, onboard and verify them, manage their accounts, accept payments, and pay them out - without building payments, compliance, or financial-services systems themselves.

This is how businesses like Shopify can help entrepreneurs run and grow their businesses. It is also the kind of infrastructure that marketplaces such as DoorDash need to coordinate money movement across large networks of restaurants, merchants, and dashers.
Connect has impact across industries. Shopify uses Stripe to embed financial services for merchants; Lugg streamlines worker onboarding and offers instant payouts; DoorLoop reduces manual customer onboarding tasks by nearly 50% with Stripe; and Sharetribe helps entrepreneurs launch and run marketplaces on Stripe.
AI is accelerating the emergence of entirely new business models: global networks of creators and experts, AI-native marketplaces, and agent-driven products that change how people discover, buy, sell, and deliver services. These businesses are more dynamic than traditional platforms: participants may operate across borders, take on different roles, and need new ways to establish trust, access financial capabilities, and get paid.
The Connect Abstractions team owns the platform primitives that make these models possible. We are building the foundational abstractions for representing participants, onboarding them safely, configuring their capabilities, and managing their lifecycle on Stripe. Our work will determine how quickly the next generation of platforms can launch, how flexibly they can evolve, and how much of Stripe they can bring to the businesses and people they serve.
Why this role
This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.
The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users?
The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to build the platform experiences behind Connect's next generation of users. You will own critical product primitives that platforms, including the fastest-growing AI companies, use to onboard, configure, and manage their users on Stripe. You will turn a clear strategic direction into products that solve hard user problems today while creating a coherent, extensible foundation for business models that are still being invented.
This role is for someone who enjoys the depth of platform work but is uncompromising about product craft and solving real user needs - both the ones users have today and will have in the future. The work is not building infra for its own sake; you will build capabilities that help our users launch a new marketplace, enable a global network to pay its contributors, or give a business entirely new ways for their end users to earn.

Bring the next generation of Connect accounts to life. Own key product areas within the account platform, translating strategy into a focused roadmap, crisp product decisions, and high-quality launches.
Build from use cases. Start with the real problems platforms face, such as onboarding a new seller, supporting a complex business model, or evolving a user's financial capabilities, and then work towards the primitives needed to solve them well.
Make sophisticated infrastructure feel simple. Partner with engineering and design to create API and product experiences that are powerful and intuitive.
See around corners. Develop a strong point of view on how AI will change platform economics, participant models, and financial workflows. Make focused foundational investments that unlock the next wave of demand.
Turn user signals into durable product investments. Work closely with users, Sales, Partnerships, and other Stripe teams to distinguish bespoke requests from patterns that should become scalable platform capabilities, connecting business needs, user needs, and platform evolution.
Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for developer experience, platform adoption, user value, and business impact, not simply features shipped.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process We believe hiring should feel like a conversation, not a test. Here’s what you can expect if you apply: Step 1 — Conversation with People & Culture (30 minutes) If your experience looks like a fit, you’ll meet with our Head of People & Culture for a video chat.

It’s a two-way conversation, we’ll learn about your background, skills, and what energizes you, and you’ll have space to ask about Revaly , our mission, and what it’s like to work here. It’s also a chance to make sure the vibes are right on both sides.

Step 2 — Conversation with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes) Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a deeper dive into your role-specific experience. We’ll talk through real scenarios, how you approach challenges, and what success looks like in this role. You’ll also get a clearer picture of the team’s goals and priorities.

Step 3 — Meet a Future Teammate (60 minutes) In this stage, you’ll meet with someone from the team you’ll work closely with. This is your chance to get an on-the-ground perspective, how the team collaborates, what day-to-day looks like, and the kind of people you’ll be building alongside.

Step 4 — 90 Day Ramp Up Presentation (30 minutes) In this final stage, we ask candidates to prepare and present a 90 day ramp up plan to the hiring manager. This is an opportunity for candidates to outline how they would approach their first 3 months in the role, what they’d aim to learn, prioritize, and accomplish.

This is a chance to show your understanding of the role, the company, and the environment we’re operating in, while giving the hiring manager a glimpse into how you think, structure your approach to learning and communicate your ideas.

We hire for both skill and fit, looking for people who are not just aligned with our values, but who will add to our culture with their ideas, energy, and perspective.

If you’ve applied for a role in Technology or Product Development, you can also expect a skill-based assessment between step 3 and 4, to help us assess some key role-based requirements.

Revaly is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities.

We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout.

Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store.

You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer.

You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

Are you a seasoned product manager looking to build experiences that millions of people rely on to discover new ways to make a living with Uber? Are you energized by creating user journeys where magical experiences, growth, and trust must work hand in hand? If so, this role might be for you.
As a Lead Product Manager your impact on the business side, onboarding, and making new drivers successful is the lifeblood that powers Uber's growth and creates a path to economic empowerment for millions of people every year.
In this role, you will envision and deliver a multi-gig experience that is intuitive, fast, globally scalable and tailored to different earner segments. You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how drivers and couriers discover new earning opportunities, maximize their earnings and manage their platform access across all of their gigs.
This role requires strong product sense, a good understanding of the driver persona and their motivations and great crossfunctional agility. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, operations, legal, and trust & safety partners to build experiences that support and scale with the speed of our business.

The Earner growth team sits at the heart of the earner lifecycle and plays a foundational role in Uber's global growth. We are responsible for maximizing the number of quality, high performing earners on the platform.

We achieve this through optimizing the onboarding experience, enabling earners to progress during their early lifecycle and by helping to maximize their earning potential through multiple gigs to increase retention. In the event that earners churn, we also focus on bringing them back to the platform.

Own the product roadmap and lead vision, definition and execution for building Uber's earner multi gig experience.
Rethink the journey - deeply understand earners, their motivations and challenges and keep making the gig discovery and recommendation experience better.
Innovate - find new ways of simplifying the user experience with new technologies.
Distill vision and strategy for the team, get all members of cross-functional team #superpumped.
Own your numbers, drive your cross-functional team of engineers, data scientist, product ops and designers to set qualitative objectives and quantitative goals -- and overachieve them.
Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results to leadership.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience.
Experience delivering highly successful and creative consumer Internet products with your fingerprints all over them - you're proud of what you've accomplished.
Data-driven: you always get the data you need, and you can distill it into an insightful story. Most importantly, you leverage data to drive strategic decisions.
Technical skills. Ability to inform and evaluate engineering decisions.

Any experience working with gig economy earners
Launching products in different international markets
Experience in building and optimizing complex user acquisition funnels or recommendation engines

The eRA Product Manager within Notre Dame Research serves as the strategic owner of the University’s electronic Research Administration (eRA) ecosystem. This position is responsible for the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of the administrative systems that support the University’s research enterprise.

The eRA Product Manager partners closely with Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and external software vendors to ensure research administration and compliance platforms align with institutional priorities, federal compliance requirements, and the evolving needs of faculty and research staff.

In this role, the eRA Product Manager acts as a high-level consultant to University leadership, translating strategic research objectives into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data integrity, compliance readiness, and proposal competitiveness.

Most immediately, the successful candidate in collaboration with the Associate Vice President of Research and the Director of Research Effectiveness and Analytics will play a defining leadership role in steering the University through a major eRA implementation, shaping the future of Notre Dame’s research infrastructure from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities Define, manage, and execute the product roadmap for the University’s electronic Research Administration systems, prioritizing enhancements and feature releases that streamline workflows and reduce administrative burden.

Serve as the primary liaison between Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and third-party software vendors to advocate for institutional needs and influence product development.

Lead system governance and integration strategy for research administration platforms, ensuring effective data exchange between eRA systems, HRIS, ERP, and other enterprise applications. Oversee research data governance practices to establish consistent standards, improve data quality, and support reliable institutional reporting and analytics.

Configure and maintain system validations and workflows to support evolving federal regulations and sponsor requirements, including NSF, NIH, USDA, and other compliance standards. Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and enhanced reporting capabilities.

Develop and maintain system documentation, business processes, and training materials to support successful adoption of system enhancements and transitions. Lead “train-the-trainer” initiatives and support change management efforts across the research community.

Monitor system performance, user feedback, and emerging industry trends to inform continuous improvement efforts. Support reporting and data visualization activities to translate research administration data into actionable insights for leadership decision-making.

Support audit readiness activities by ensuring accurate system configurations, data integrity, and compliance documentation. Participate in vendor user groups, professional organizations, and research administration communities to stay informed on best practices and emerging technologies.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Research Administration, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in research administration, enterprise systems management, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in a leadership, Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar strategic systems role.

Experience supporting enterprise-level software implementations, preferably within research administration, ERP, or higher education environments. Expert understanding of the research grant lifecycle, including pre-award, post-award, and compliance functions.

Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, integrations, and data governance principles. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct supervisory authority. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify operational trends.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including faculty and senior leadership. Ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a dynamic environment. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail and compliance requirements.

Preferred qualifications Experience working within higher education research administration environments. Familiarity with eRA systems, ERP platforms, and SaaS-to-on-premises data integrations. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Knowledge of federal research compliance regulations and sponsored program administration. Please include a cover letter and resume to be considered for this role. Salary up to $113,500, commensurate with experience. Applications due by July 27 2026.

Better Money Strike is the Bitcoin company. With Strike , you can buy and sell bitcoin, pay bills, and borrow against your holdings. From individuals to businesses, Strike is purpose-built for every step of the Bitcoin journey.

Available in more than 100 countries — including the U.S., Europe, Latin America, and Africa — Strike is building a better financial system powered by Bitcoin. Bitcoin is better money. Strike is how you use it. Role: Strike is where people around the world send, save, and spend money on bitcoin rails.

For a product like that, customer trust is a feature in and of itself.

As Trust Product Manager, you'll own the features that make customers confident keeping their money with Strike : account security controls, verified support experiences, beneficiary planning, account management, and the systems like KYC/B, transaction limits, account restrictions that keep fraudsters out without getting in the way of good customers.

You'll ship customer-facing features, and you'll own the foundations underneath them, turning what most companies treat as friction into experiences customers actually appreciate.

You'll succeed by shipping trust-building features customers love, minimizing fraud, maintaining compliance, and protecting the health and integrity of the Strike ecosystem. This position is available for candidates located in the eastern US time zone.

What You’ll Do: Serve as the voice of the customer (internal customer too!) and intimately understand the products we offer as well as their potential fraud vectors and blind spots Work closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Data to uncover and understand needs Partner with cross-functional peers to define, prioritize, and deliver a roadmap and product that maximize impact to financial risk management and our fraud strategy Own our Fraud KPIs and partner with Data and Finance to iterate on their definition as needed Establish and track success metrics for various features and initiatives, including operational efficiencies Support and motivate cross-functional teams through an inclusive and collaborative mindset Qualifications: At least 4 years of experience in product management, with at least 2 of those years in trust/fraud related teams A highly experimental mindset to drive innovation amidst uncertainty or ambiguity (e.g., new processes, teams, systems) Vast experience working with designers and user researchers Empathy to work with a diverse array of cross functional peers and stakeholders Resourcefulness, pragmatism and roll-up the sleeves mentality Excellent verbal and written communication skills Experience and interest for Bitcoin and Fintech is a plus US-Based Positions Salary range: $162K - 190K Equity in a high-growth startup Health, dental, and vision insurance premium contributions; short & long-term disability insurance and basic life insurance Cell phone and internet reimbursement Flexible PTO, sick leave & parental leave Access to a company 401k plan We do not make hiring decisions based on educational history whatsoever.

Our Founder is a college dropout. We employ high school dropouts, PHD candidates and everything in-between. We do not hire credentials. We simply hire talented, passionate individuals who are excited to be a part of our team.

Swiftly is a retail digital technology company headquartered in the Bay Area that empowers regional and independent grocers to compete in a digital-first world.

Swiftly provides best-in-class app, web, loyalty, and e-commerce solutions to retailer partners without SaaS fees, instead driving revenue through its retail media network and sharing profits with retailers. With 70+ retailer banners and Series C funding, Swiftly is the first in the industry to seamlessly connect digital and in-store shopping.

AI is at the core of how we build, operate, and scale, powering everything from shopper personalization to internal engineering velocity. Our solutions, including Audience Optimizer™, Alcohol Cashback, and Offsite Campaigns, drive shopper engagement and brand success.

Swiftly is searching for a Principal Product Managerwho will lead and own the product development lifecycle.This role will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution, balancing strategic prioritization with hands-on execution.

This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to apply AI-driven automation across retail workflows, delivering innovative products that improve operational efficiency, and enhance the digital shopping experience. This is a full-time contract role. We use Deel as the employer of record and contract.

Responsibilities Include: Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap for AI-powered shopping experiences and digital marketing solutions Lead AI initiatives that automate complex marketing workflows, reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency Partner with Marketing, Engineering, and customers to understand business processes, identify pain points, and translate them into AI-powered product opportunities Drive the design and development of AI-powered products, intelligent workflows, and AI agents that automate complex business processes and improve operational efficiency Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable AI product solutions Partner with engineering, design, and business teams to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and technical feasibility Stay informed about AI and retail technology trends to identify opportunities for product innovation and workflow automation Gather feedback from internal and external stakeholders to identify pain points, opportunities, and enhancements for the platform Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure success and guide future improvements Other related duties as assigned Required Qualifications: 7+ years of product management or engineering experience, delivering highly technical products Experience with subscription products, pricing, and/or demonstrated success in improving user retention Demonstrated experience building products powered by LLMs, AI agents, or intelligent workflow automation.

Ability to identify operational processes and apply AI technologies to automate decision-making, improve efficiency, and reduce manual work Demonstrated data-driven approach to problem solving by gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data, using customer feedback and business insights to drive product decisions Experience managing a portfolio of products.

Experience working across multiple engineering teams simultaneously Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous environments Healthy balance of both analytical and creative thinking with a desire to discover and fulfill the needs of clients as well as end users Experience with SaaS platforms, developer ecosystems, or enterprise-scale solutions Excellent communication and collaboration skills Preferred Qualifications: Experience in a hyper-growth startup environment  Demonstrated ability across customer segmentation, new product strategy, execution, and product analytics  Passion for technology and a commitment to expanding technical knowledge  Working For Swiftly We are working on a set of problems that require the best in the industry to get right.

Our employees are the pillars of the future of the company and they are treated and compensated as such. We're a growing team of experienced industry professionals building an organization that can solve tough problems and values a collaborative environment.

Every Swiftly employee: -Has demonstrated the ability to work collaboratively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment -Takes ownership of their domain from the ground up, from inception through deployment to customers -Leaves their ego at the door and ensures the best idea leaves the room -Is always experimenting with new technologies and learning new skillsets If you've ever wanted to work on a project that blends a gorgeous consumer experience, sophisticated logistics, and scale that rivals the largest technology players, Swiftly is the place for you.

About Us: Zensurance is redefining commercial insurance for Canadian businesses. As a leading InsurTech, we make getting the right coverage simple, fast, and accessible through a digital-first experience. Our platform combines advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver tailored insurance solutions that help businesses thrive.

Zensurance has been recognized for its rapid growth and industry impact: ✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 (2023, 2024, 2025) ✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 (2024, 2025) ✅ Top Insurance Employers (2022) At Zensurance , we value ownership, collaboration, and innovation.

Our team thrives on solving complex challenges, challenging the status quo, and making a real impact in an industry ready for change. If you're looking to build something meaningful in a fast-growing, customer-focused company, we’d love to hear from you!

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of our products and drive company-wide impact! This is a senior-level, subject-matter-expert role that combines strategic vision with hands-on leadership across multiple teams.

The Product team works to design, develop, and manage user-centered digital products that align with our business goals. Through close collaboration with stakeholders, user feedback, and data-driven insights, we deliver innovative and reliable solutions that move the business forward.

Reporting to the Director of Product, you’ll define and deliver a 2–3 year product strategy that aligns with the company’s long-term vision. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape development practices, influence roadmaps, and ensure consistent product direction across teams.

As an individual contributor and domain expert, you’ll raise the bar for Product Management through mentorship, technical depth, and scalable processes that promote fact-based problem solving and continuous improvement. This is a remote-first role within the GTA.

Responsibilities: Act as a strategic thought leader, creating clear and inspiring narratives that align teams and stakeholders around a shared product vision.

Define, own, and gain buy-in for the 2-3 year product vision of the assigned domain, and develop a concrete 18-24 month strategy and roadmap that ensures alignment with the overall product and business strategy. Collaborate with Product leaders to co-develop and optimize the overarching 18-24 month product strategy and roadmap.

Partner with Product leadership to shape cross-domain priorities, coordinate resources, and maintain alignment across multiple teams. Serve as the strategic hub and arbiter for product and development teams, resolving significant dependencies and conflicting priorities to drive successful delivery.

Lead end-to-end problem solving from strategy to execution, balancing business and technical needs to maximize impact and ROI. Proactively identify high-value opportunities, assess risks, and align stakeholders on the best path forward.

Collaborate with Engineering leadership to ensure the future state of the product and technical strategy aligns with long-term goals. Establish and share best practices that strengthen strategic planning and execution across the Product team.

Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to raise the organization’s overall strategic and delivery capabilities. Mentor Product Managers on advanced discovery, stakeholder alignment, and strategic execution.

Requirements: University degree or college diploma in a recognized technical, vocational or academic program (preferably in Engineering or Computer Science) or equivalent work 10+ years of experience in digital or software Product Management. 5+ years of experience as a senior individual contributor or an equivalent role in Product Management, with proven hands-on experience leading and implementing company-wide strategic initiatives across multiple product domains and teams.

Proven success owning the full product lifecycle, from 0 to 1 through scale, ideally in a complex, customer-facing platform or self-serve digital product. Strong ability to dive into technical architecture, understand complex data flows, and make informed decisions about platform, infrastructure, and APIs.

Skilled in building and executing product strategy and long-term roadmaps that tie to business outcomes. Deep understanding of strategic frameworks, linking day-to-day execution with long-term company value. Advanced experience in feature planning, resource management, and prioritization across multiple teams.

Proven track record of improving and scaling product processes in collaboration with product leadership. Strong discovery skills, consistently identifying the right problems, validating with data, and applying structured frameworks.

What You Bring: A thoughtful, data-driven approach to decision making and the confidence to prioritize what matters most. A genuine passion for developing the product craft and problem-solving skills of other product managers. Clear and persuasive communication skills, especially when working with executives and cross-functional teams.

You can work independently, navigate ambiguity with ease, and deliver results. Strategic thinking with a systems mindset, anticipating how today’s decisions shape tomorrow’s outcomes. A collaborative and growth-oriented mindset with a passion for mentoring and elevating other Product Managers.

Benefits & Perks at Zensurance : At Zensurance , we know that when our people thrive, so does our business. That’s why we offer a flexible, people-first work environment designed to support your well-being, growth, and success. 💻 Work Your Way

We're defining a new category of technology as the human<>agent operating system by inventing new ways for teams to work together more efficiently. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products.

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our Enterprise Data Governance team. Our team owns the strategic platform capabilities that govern the full lifecycle of customer data, including retention, migration, auditing, export, and operational governance.

We are foundational to Asana's enterprise success, providing the controls and policy frameworks that allow large organizations to meet complex regulatory requirements and securely adopt AI.

As a Product Manager here, you will bridge the gap between technical infrastructure and enterprise customer needs, partnering closely with Engineering, Security, Legal, and Design to reduce operational burden and build the governance foundation that helps people and AI agents collaborate safely at scale.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of enterprise trust, regulatory compliance, and platform strategy, directly driving Asana’s growth in highly regulated industries.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Define and execute the long-term strategy and roadmap for Enterprise and Data Governance, building the platform capabilities that help organizations securely adopt AI while meeting evolving security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Own the product strategy for customer data lifecycle management, including retention, migration, auditing, export, deletion, recovery, and governance controls that are foundational to enterprise trust.
Lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Compliance, Support, and GTM teams to deliver governance capabilities that serve the needs of the world’s largest enterprises and highly regulated industries.
Build the governance foundation for human and AI agents by developing policy controls, auditability, data governance, and administrative capabilities that enable safe, transparent, and compliant AI at scale.
Drive strategic investments that improve the reliability, operability, and scalability of critical governance infrastructure while reducing operational burden for customers and internal teams.
Partner with Security and Compliance to anticipate emerging regulations and translate them into platform capabilities that accelerate enterprise adoption and strengthen customer trust.
Define measurable business outcomes and success metrics across enterprise trust, governance adoption, operational efficiency, and platform reliability, using data and AI to prioritize investments and guide execution.

Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
6+ years of experience in Product Management, with deep expertise in identity/authentication systems, security, regulatory compliance, or B2B enterprise platform solutions.
Highly comfortable modeling complex data relationships, managing integration complexity, and translating technical protocols into clear, holistic UX flows.
Experienced in owning strategy for problem spaces that require coordination across multiple teams, evaluating competing investment options, and anticipating market shifts or security threats ahead of results.
Proven ability to build durable alignment across teams by navigating disagreement, resolving conflicts, and leading executive-facing reviews and discussions.
Skilled at orchestrating delivery across multiple teams, thoughtfully sequencing platform initiatives, and prioritizing high-craft MVPs.
Passionate about mentoring other PMs, raising the bar for product craft across teams, and evangelizing PM best practices throughout the R&D organization.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision and roadmap for Render's datastores portfolio, with our Postgres offering at the center. You will define what a modern managed database experience looks like, including how database products will adapt to new state patterns from agents and how agents as users of state-keeping products should be accommodated.
You'll drive the technical and strategic direction for Render Postgres and our broader data layer, working directly with your team and infrastructure engineering to shape architectural decisions. You'll engage with Render's customers and our product development teams to develop a deep understanding of their data needs and build conviction about where the datastores portfolio needs to go next.

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Render's datastores, anchored on Postgres. Your scope spans provisioning and lifecycle management, high availability and disaster recovery, backups and point-in-time recovery, scaling and performance, connection management, and the extension ecosystem.
Drive prioritization across Render's data investments, balancing the leverage of foundational reliability work — replication, failover, storage performance — against near-term product and business needs, and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs.
Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's data layer, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for durability, performance, and operational simplicity. Databases are where customer trust is won or lost, so an instinct for reliability and data safety is essential.
Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how managed Postgres needs to evolve to serve AI-native builders — from vector workloads and retrieval pipelines to databases that are spun up, branched, and torn down programmatically by agents at scale.
Set the standard for how developers experience data on Render, providing clear guidance, sensible defaults, and abstractions that make it easy for teams to run production databases with confidence — without needing a DBA on staff.

7+ years in Product Management, with the majority spent on databases, data infrastructure, developer tools, or platform products.
Familiarity with Postgres — its architecture, operational model, ecosystem, and the tradeoffs teams face running it in production. Bonus if you have strong perspective on how agentic workloads and AI-native applications are reshaping database usage patterns.
Deep developer empathy, for both internal engineering teams and our customers, and the technical depth to make sound architectural tradeoffs in collaboration with engineering.
A track record of taking ambiguous, high-stakes reliability and infrastructure problems and turning them into clear strategy and shipped outcomes.
Strong communication and storytelling skills.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire's financial products are among the most powerful and differentiated value props we offer — and among the most consequential for both sides of our marketplace. We extend net-60 and net-90 payment terms to retailers on behalf of brands, offer the Faire Pay credit card with 3% back on purchases, and are actively building brand financing.

These products do something our partners simply cannot do on their own: absorb risk, deploy capital efficiently, and unlock purchasing behavior that drives growth across the platform.
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the entire Faire Pay portfolio — someone who can run disciplined day-to-day execution on Faire Pay while simultaneously developing the longer-term strategic roadmap for how financial products evolve as a core business line. This means thinking clearly about unit economics and cost of capital, building conviction around where Faire has durable competitive advantages, and shipping products that move real business metrics.

Own strategy and roadmap for Faire's financial products. Set the multi-year direction for how Faire Pay, net terms, brand financing, and future financial products evolve, and build the prioritized, financially grounded roadmap to get there.
Drive Faire Pay adoption and marketplace impact. Expand the invited retailer cohort, improve activation and retention across the funnel, and demonstrate that financial products are a meaningful growth lever for the core marketplace, not just a standalone offering.
Own the unit economics. Think in contribution margin, cost of capital, and payback periods. Optimize interchange, manage loss rates, and identify where structural advantages exist versus where we need to earn our way in.
Partner deeply across Finance, Risk, Legal, Data Science, and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving without losing momentum.
Build the infrastructure for scale. Partner to develop the data infrastructure, risk frameworks, and operational foundations needed to grow financial products responsibly, from underwriting logic to regulatory compliance.
Communicate clearly at every altitude. Translate complex, technical topics (cost of capital, credit risk, underwriting tradeoffs) for a wide range of audiences, from engineering partners to senior leadership.

10+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated ability to own complex, cross-functional products end to end.
Genuine fintech depth. You've built and shipped financial products — credit, lending, payments, BNPL, or similar — and you understand the mechanics: underwriting logic, cost of capital, credit risk, contribution margin, and regulatory constraints. You don't need to be a finance expert, but you need to be able to lead the room.
Business equation fluency. You think comfortably in unit economics. You can model whether a new product makes sense given Faire's cost of capital, estimate cohort-level payback periods, and identify structural advantages worth betting on.
Strategic clarity with hands-on execution. You can zoom out and develop a defensible multi-year point of view, then zoom back in to write crisp PRDs, drive sprint-level execution, and unblock your team.
Customer and business model empathy. You deeply understand how retailers and brands run their businesses — their cash flow cycles, how they think about credit and payment terms, and what makes them trust a financial product. You design around customer needs, not just what's technically feasible.
Cross-functional influence across Finance, Risk, Legal, Data Science, and Engineering, and a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders while maintaining momentum.
Structured problem solving. You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, don't mistake activity for progress, and diagnose root causes rather than escalate.
High learning velocity. Financial products sit at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, risk, and regulatory complexity.
Proven ability to influence at the executive level and to communicate complex topics with clarity and conviction across audiences.
B2B marketplace experience is a strong plus — particularly familiarity with two-sided dynamics, competing customer objectives, and the structural differences between B2B and consumer credit.

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we've helped millions of people across more than 40 countries buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on the rails Luno has spent over a decade building. The portfolio spans Luno Institutional and BlockTower, the group’s stablecoin issuance business.

You will own how businesses and institutions get access to Luno, and to everything built on Luno’s rails. Whatever door a customer comes through, whether it’s institutional, a partner’s brand, or another business line in the group, your job is to make access fast, trusted and configurable.

You will run onboarding and verification as a single platform: one machine, configured per business line and per region, where each business line owns its own risk appetite and due diligence policy and you own everything that executes it.

You will sit with institutional customers to understand where onboarding loses them, work directly with verification vendors, and treat evolving regulators’ requirements as design inputs rather than blockers.

You’re joining the team that built and maintains Luno’s entire identity verification system across all markets for retail and institutional customers and will need to carefully balance how we build new features, while maintaining the integrity of our existing integrations and processes.

Own the business and institutional onboarding platform end-to-end: KYB, verification, screening, periodic refresh, and the journey from first application to first transaction
Configuration per business line: Luno Institutional and BlockTower each carry their own CDD standards and risk appetite, in segregated environments, on the platform you own
Measure time-to-onboard and abandonment: find where institutions drop out, discover why, and design the changes that fix it
Own the relationship with verification vendors: integration, performance, cost and our roadmap
Extend the platform to multi-region and global onboarding: working with legal, risk and country teams to turn a regulatory position into a compliant product
Partner with our operations teams: reduce manual effort per case, so specialists handle the complex work and automations handle the rest

You have built products in onboarding, identity, KYC/KYB, compliance tooling or an adjacent domain
You are technically comfortable where product meets integration: vendor APIs, environment configuration, and how identity data moves between systems, in enough depth to make good trade-offs with engineers
You are rigorous with data: you can find where a journey leaks, quantify what it costs, and prioritise accordingly

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to help build our Occupational Health bet inside New Ventures based in Brazil . This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.
Occupational health is one of the largest, most regulated, and most stubbornly analog corners of corporate wellbeing.

In Brazil alone, it is a multi-billion real market: every company is legally required to run occupational exams, manage regulatory compliance (NR-01 and the new psychosocial-risk mandate, eSocial reporting), and look after the health of its workforce.

Yet the industry still runs on paper, manual scheduling, fragmented clinics, and reports nobody reads. We intend to rebuild it, at AI speed.
You will partner directly with the Founder/GM of the Occupational Health bet as the product lead of a small, single-threaded squad. This is a 0-to-1 build: the thesis is set, the market is chosen, but the product, the workflow, and the operating model are still being invented.

You report to the VP Product, New Ventures, and you'll work daily with the Founder/GM, design and engineering craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents to take this bet from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, first paying customers, and scale.

Own product for the Occupational Health bet: translate the Founder/GM's commercial thesis and market insight into product requirements, sequencing, and a roadmap that gets us to paying customers fast, and keep reshaping it as we learn.
Redefine the workflow, don't digitize the paperwork: question every legacy step, the manual exam booking, the paper ASO, the compliance theater, and rebuild it around the member, the company, and AI. A faster PDF is not the answer.
Make AI the core mechanic, not a feature: work with engineering to embed AI into scheduling, triage, compliance reporting, and the back office, so a lean squad can do what an incumbent's much larger operation does today.
Build for regulated ground truth: work hand in hand with legal, compliance, and SST domain experts to make sure the product is correct on NR-01, eSocial, and psychosocial-risk requirements before it is fast or delightful. In this market, compliance failures are not a bug, they are existential.
Drive planning and measurement: set OKRs, goals, and success metrics for the bet jointly with the Founder/GM, and report progress in a way that is honest about what's working and what isn't.
Work close to the customer: get in front of HR and SST buyers, clinics, and brokers yourself, alongside the commercial team, so product decisions are grounded in what you've heard directly, not what's been relayed to you.
Lead design and engineering execution: run backlog, rituals, and delivery with your design and engineering craft leads, keeping a small team focused and shipping weekly, not planning for a quarter.
Bring judgment in ambiguity: make calls with incomplete information, defend the ones that matter, and change your mind fast when the evidence says to.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

6+ years of product management experience, including time spent building a product from zero to one.
Experience in, or close proximity to, a highly regulated or compliance-heavy market (health, insurance, benefits, HR tech, occupational safety, or similar), and comfort making product calls where "move fast" has real limits.
Genuinely AI-native: you reach for AI as the default way to do more with less, direct agents to compress manual work, and are comfortable being a beginner on things AI changes every month.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills: able to use data and metrics to generate insight, prioritize ruthlessly, and know what to measure when the business itself is still being defined.
Entrepreneurial and self-driven, with a bias to ship and sell as the way to learn, balanced with the judgment to know which corners cannot be cut.
Comfortable operating without a playbook: this bet doesn't have an established product organization or years of process behind it; you'll help build both as you go.
Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

The Operations Platform team’s mission is to design, develop, and maintain the critical infrastructure, tooling & automation needed by Customer Trust & Safety (CTS) Operations to safely protect our customers.

Navigate tradeoffs and negotiate timelines with internal and external stakeholders, communicating with precision in both writing and conversation. Prototype rapidly.

Use tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, Codex, or similar to explore, validate, and demonstrate new ideas yourself, so you can align a team on direction with a working artifact rather than a document. Compress the busywork .

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
The Distribution tribe owns how Mews connects hotel properties to 400+ OTA and channel management platforms, including Booking.com, Expedia, and Airbnb. You would join as the Staff Product Manager leading our biggest strategic initiative for 2026: building a native Channel Manager experience powered by SiteMinder, bringing OTA connectivity fully inside Mews so hotels never need to switch tools.
This role exists above day to day execution. There is already a PM handling that layer. You come in to own the full product strategy and set direction the way a Staff Engineer owns an architectural domain, working through a landscape of hundreds of third party APIs, each with their own schemas, edge cases, and contractual obligations, while protecting 2,800 existing customers who cannot be disrupted during the transition.
What you would do
Set and defend product strategy for Distribution's core platform while the new native Channel Manager experience ships in parallel, ensuring zero disruption to the 2,800+ existing SiteMinder customers who depend on current flows
Own the technical product decisions that blur the line between engineering and product: API architecture, third party integration patterns, legacy versus new codebase trade offs, and how to handle the dozens of edge cases and contractual obligations that come with OTA partnerships
Manage alignment across Commercial, Customer Success, SiteMinder, individual OTAs, and your engineering team, balancing what customers need, what OTAs require, and what is technically feasible
Work directly with senior engineers on architecture discussions and trade off decisions, bringing full technical context to every decision rather than relying on others to translate complexity
Build and maintain AI assisted workflows for synthesizing partner documentation, API specs, and cross team requirements, so complex technical context is easier for the wider team to act on
AI Fluency Level 3: in this role, that means redesigning how the Distribution team handles hundreds of pages of partner API documentation and contractual detail, using AI to synthesize and structure that material rather than reading it manually.

It means creating a repeatable method for this synthesis that your PM, engineers, and cross functional partners can reuse. And it means actively checking that synthesis against the source material yourself before it shapes a technical or strategic decision, since a missed edge case here can affect thousands of live customers.

What you would bring
Demonstrable progression to Staff or Principal PM level (IC PM to Group PM, Director of Product, or equivalent) with proven outcomes on very complex, large scale projects
Experience shipping products with complex third party integrations at scale: API heavy, partner dependent, high reliability production environments where failure is not an option
Strong technical fluency and ability to operate as a peer to senior engineers, engaging directly in architecture discussions and making trade off decisions with full technical context, not approximations
A track record of owning outcomes end to end, moving fast in uncertain environments, and operating effectively in smaller, direct team settings
AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands on experience: you have redesigned how you or your team uses AI, built an approach others follow, and you actively check AI output before relying on it

Direct experience at a PMS, CRS, or channel manager company (SiteMinder, Amadeus, Oracle Hospitality, D-edge)
Hands on experience with SiteMinder, iHotelier, D-edge, Booking.com connectivity products, or similar OTA side platforms
Track record leading a major platform migration or legacy modernization

Hotels currently move between Mews and separate channel managers to reach the full OTA ecosystem. We are building that natively, and the market timing and scope of the problem make this the highest impact distribution role in hospitality tech right now.
