Established in 2020, Riot Singapore is a game development studio focused on delivering great experiences to our players. We partner with our Los Angeles headquarters on game development for League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, VALORANT, and unpublished R&D products. Riot Singapore is seeking talented, passionate Rioters with backgrounds in all areas of game development to build games that make it better to be a player.
That’s where you come in.
Game Product Managers at Riot lead passionate teams to create and evolve products and experiences for our players. We seek to deeply understand our product’s audience and drive strategy to create value for players and for Riot. We help concept, build, and influence projects at all stages of production.
As Principal Game Product Manager, Cosmetics for Teamfight Tactics (TFT) , you will lead the TFT Cosmetics team within the Acquisitions, Expression, and Events (AXE) initiative. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and product outcomes for TFT's cosmetics portfolio, spanning existing offerings, new content types, exclusive content, store features, and long term cosmetics research and development.
This is an individual contributor role in which you will serve as the product lead for a multidisciplinary team in Singapore, setting product direction, defining priorities, and driving product decisions across producers, artists, designers, analysts, researchers, marketing partners, and other specialists.

While you will not have formal people management responsibilities, you will be expected to lead through influence, bringing teams together around a shared strategy and empowering them to deliver exceptional player experiences.
Working closely with TFT leadership and stakeholders in our Los Angeles headquarters, you will balance player insights, creative ambition, and commercial outcomes to shape the future of TFT's cosmetics portfolio. Success in this role means creating cosmetics that resonate with players, building a healthy and innovative portfolio, and establishing a long term strategy that supports TFT's continued growth.

Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for TFT's cosmetics portfolio, driving player engagement and commercial success.
Lead the multidisciplinary cosmetics team by defining product priorities and aligning partners around them.
Collaborate with artists to create content that resonates deeply with players, elevating their creative vision to achieve product goals.
Manage product KPIs, leveraging performance reporting, experimentation, revenue models, and deep dive analysis and research to improve decision making.
Identify product challenges and opportunities, including cosmetics research and development, formulate strategies and plans, and build stakeholder buy in.
Develop decision frameworks, product briefs, and other artefacts that guide downstream decisions and create clarity across teams.
Partner with Production to translate strategy into executable plans, including roadmap sequencing, capacity planning, prioritization, and sustainable live operations.
Navigate the broader TFT and Riot organization to drive cohesive action across Marketing, Regional Publishing, IP and League Creative, Brand Partnerships, and other cross functional partners.

8+ years of Product Management experience in the games industry, with a strong focus on live-service games where cosmetics and virtual goods are core to the product.
Proven experience owning product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and commercial outcomes while leading cross-functional teams through influence.
Deep expertise in cosmetics, live-service monetization, and player-facing content, with experience shaping product portfolios and driving long-term strategy.
Deep understanding of cosmetics-driven free-to-play games and the player motivations, progression systems, and live-service mechanics that drive long-term engagement.
Proven ability to shape product decisions through player insights, data, commercial thinking, and creative judgement.
Experience partnering with artists, designers, creative directors, and Production to translate creative vision into successful product strategy.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical skills, using product performance, player behaviour, experimentation, and market trends to drive strategic decisions.

Experience working in Agile production environments.
Experience working in a cross-geographical, multi-team environment.
Active Teamfight Tactics player with a deep understanding of the game's systems, player base, and cosmetics ecosystem.

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.
That's where you come in.

As a Product Manager focused on Meta Systems for VALORANT Mobile, you will help shape the out-of-match experience that supports players before, between, and after every tactical fight.
You will work on player-facing systems including, but not limited to, progression, social features, asset display, party-up experience, player identity, and other systems that deepen long-term engagement. Your goal is to ensure VALORANT Mobile does not only feel great in the round, but also gives players meaningful reasons to return, connect, express themselves, and grow over time.
This role requires strong player empathy, structured product thinking, and the ability to translate ambiguous player needs into clear product direction. You will partner closely with Quantum Studio, our co-development partner, as well as Riot VALORANT teams, designers, engineers, publishing stakeholders, and other Riot partners to define feature goals, review implementation quality, and continuously improve the player experience through data, research, and product intuition.
As a Rioter in China, you’ll join a team of culturally diverse professionals who share a passion for games and a commitment to putting players first. To support Riot’s collaborative culture in our China offices, we operate without traditional hierarchical titles. What matters here is ownership, autonomy, and impact, not what’s printed on your badge.

Drive the product direction and execution support for VALORANT Mobile meta systems, including progression, social, party-up, asset display, player identity, and other out-of-match player experiences.
Partner closely with Quantum Studio to define product goals, feature requirements, user flows, experience principles, and acceptance criteria for new and existing meta system features.
Review and refine Quantum Studio’s feature implementation throughout the development cycle, ensuring the final player experience is intuitive, polished, and aligned with VALORANT’s product quality bar.
Use player behavior data, research insights, competitive references, and product intuition to identify opportunities that improve engagement, retention, social connection, and long-term player motivation.
Collaborate with Riot VALORANT teams, publishing stakeholders, and other product owners to ensure meta system direction aligns with broader VALORANT product principles, version planning, live operations, and player needs.
Support the planning and prioritization of meta system improvements across patches, balancing player impact, development cost, business goals, and delivery timelines.
Act as the voice of VALORANT Mobile players in the meta system space, ensuring features serve both core tactical shooter players and broader mobile audiences.
Monitor post-launch feature performance and player feedback, then build actionable optimization plans with Quantum Studio and relevant Riot stakeholders for future iterations.
Contribute to cross-functional discussions on how meta systems connect with gameplay, monetization, content, social, and live service strategies.

5+ years of experience in product management, game operations, system design, or live service games, preferably with experience in mobile games.
Experience owning or supporting player-facing systems such as progression, social, party, profile, collection, achievement, mission, onboarding, or other engagement-related systems.
Strong product judgment and player empathy, with the ability to identify player needs and translate them into clear product requirements and experience improvements.
Ability to work through moderately complex product problems, evaluate trade-offs, and propose practical solutions within defined constraints.
Strong data literacy, with experience using engagement, retention, funnel, social, or feature usage data to evaluate product performance and guide iteration.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with experience working closely with design, engineering, publishing, analytics, research, or external development partners.
Experience working in a co-development or distributed team environment, including aligning stakeholders across different teams, cultures, or regions.
Fluent in Mandarin and English.

Deep passion for competitive multiplayer games, tactical shooters, or mobile live service games.
Experience working on meta systems for a major live service title, especially systems related to progression, social connection, player identity, or long-term engagement.
Strong understanding of mobile player behavior and how meta systems support retention, session motivation, social play, and content discovery.
Familiarity with VALORANT, its player motivations, competitive ecosystem, cosmetics culture, and overall product identity.
Experience using player research, community feedback, and market references to shape product direction.
Experience working with co-development partners, external studios, or large-scale distributed development teams on feature delivery and quality review.
职位介绍
作为 VALORANT Mobile 团队负责 Meta Systems 的产品经理 ，你将参与塑造玩家在每一场战斗前、战斗间隙以及战斗结束后的整体游戏体验。
你将负责的玩家体验系统包括但不限于局内外成长、社交功能、资产展示、组队体验、玩家身份表达，以及其他能够提升长期参与度的局外系统。你的目标是确保 VALORANT Mobile 不只是在对局内有出色的战术竞技体验，也能在对局外持续给玩家提供回归、连接、表达自我与长期成长的理由。
这个职位需要你具备强烈的玩家同理心、结构化的产品思考能力，以及将模糊玩家需求转化为清晰产品方向的能力。你将与我们的联合研发伙伴 Quantum Studio，以及 Riot VALORANT 团队、设计、工程、发行团队和其他 Riot 内部伙伴密切合作，定义功能目标，审核落地质量，并通过数据、研究与产品判断持续优化玩家体验。
在 Riot 中国办公室，你将加入一支由不同文化背景的专业伙伴组成的团队。我们共同热爱游戏，也始终坚持以玩家为中心。为了支持 Riot 在中国办公室的协作文化，我们不强调传统层级头衔。真正重要的是你所承担的责任、展现的自主性，以及最终创造的影响力。
职责描述
推动 VALORANT Mobile Meta Systems 的产品方向与落地支持，包括局内外成长、社交、组队、资产展示、玩家身份表达，以及其他局外玩家体验系统。
与光子工作室联合研发伙伴紧密合作，定义新功能与现有功能的产品目标、功能需求、用户流程、体验原则和验收标准。

s.h: 在开发周期中持续审核并优化联合研发伙伴的功能实现，确保最终玩家体验直观、精致，并符合 VALORANT 的产品质量标准。
s.t:
结合玩家行为数据、用户研究、竞品参考与产品判断，识别能够提升参与度、留存、社交连接和长期玩家动机的优化机会。
与 Riot VALORANT 团队、发行团队以及其他产品负责人合作，确保 Meta Systems 的方向与更广泛的 VALORANT 产品原则、版本规划、运营节奏和玩家需求保持一致。
支持不同版本中 Meta Systems 优化内容的规划和优先级排序，在玩家影响、研发成本、业务目标和交付时间之间做出合理取舍。
代表 VALORANT Mobile 玩家在 Meta Systems 领域提出清晰观点，确保相关功能既能服务核心战术射击玩家，也能兼顾更广泛的移动端玩家群体。
追踪功能上线后的表现与玩家反馈，并与联合研发伙伴和相关 Riot 团队一起制定可执行的后续优化计划。
基本要求
拥有 5 年以上产品管理、游戏运营、系统设计或长线运营游戏相关经验，有移动游戏经验者优先。
曾负责或参与过玩家体验系统，例如成长、社交、组队、个人资料、收藏、成就、任务、新手引导或其他与玩家参与度相关的系统。
具备良好的产品判断力和玩家同理心，能够识别玩家需求，并将其转化为清晰的产品需求和体验优化方案。
能够处理具有一定复杂度的产品问题，评估不同方案的取舍，并在明确约束下提出务实可行的解决方案。
具备良好的数据理解能力，能够使用参与度、留存、转化漏斗、社交行为或功能使用数据来评估产品表现并指导后续迭代。

Technical Product Managers combine deep technical knowledge and experience with product leadership capabilities to enable Riot Games to deliver critical products and supporting systems to players. You will develop and execute development strategies on Riot's products and technologies while leading diverse teams to deliver creative solutions to our most difficult technical challenges.
As a Senior Technical Product Manager on Riot’s Social SDK team, you will lead the vision, strategy, and product discovery for game-agnostic social capabilities that power every Riot game globally.

Working closely with engineering and cross-functional partners, you will drive the planning, development, and integration of core platform features—including voice and text chat, player presence, and shared social interfaces—enabling teams to bring innovative social experiences to players faster.

In this role, you will help shape the next generation of Riot’s social platform and support the launch of future games with scalable, player-focused solutions, reporting to Product Leadership within the Social Platform team.

Develop the technical product vision and development strategy for Riot’s Social SDK team and collaborate with other platform teams in the social space
Manage all essential customer and partner relationships including game teams and other internal Riot teams that will integrate with Riot’s social systems
Manage the product team backlog, create a product roadmap, foster a culture of improvement, and facilitate development practices for the team
Actively manage project scope as a result of customer and partner communications and ensure the product team is aligned with Riot's objectives
Review and develop service-level agreements and goals with all core customers
Partner and collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Technical, Design, and Quality Leads on the Riot Social SDK team to align on the product and technical plan the team executes against.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
7+ years of relevant industry experience, preferably on services / API technical product teams
Understand API-based products, primary components, and customer experience (developer experience)
Excellent team leadership, ability to refine technical product vision
Understand operational and development challenges and conflict resolution techniques

Hands-on experience leading agile (scrum) teams
Familiarity with social systems and platforms
Understand product management and how to navigate around constraints while finding balanced solutions
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.
At Riot Games, we put players first . That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

Scopely is looking for a Product Manager to join the Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis.
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top 10 gross revenue Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

As a Product Manager on the Star Trek Fleet Command team, you will help drive key initiatives that support player engagement and monetization. Working alongside Product, Design, Economy, Marketing, and Analytics teams, you'll support the planning, execution, and optimization of in-game events, features, and offers that improve player experience and business performance.
Support the planning and execution of the live content calendar, including events and offers
Analyze player behavior and game data to identify trends and opportunities for growth
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver engaging content that meets both player needs and business goals
Work closely with economy and game design to ensure progression systems remain balanced and rewarding
Monitor performance of features and events, and recommend improvements based on data and player feedback
Assist in developing product documentation, roadmaps, and KPIs for key initiatives
Contribute to competitive analysis and help build business cases for new content and features
Support testing and experimentation efforts to validate product hypotheses

Experience in product management, ideally within free-to-play mobile games or live service games
Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to inform decisions
Understanding of core F2P mechanics, player retention strategies, and monetization best practices
Collaborative mindset and ability to work across multiple teams and disciplines
Excellent communication and organizational skills
A passion for games and player-centric thinking

Experience with live operations or event management in a mobile game
Familiarity with game economy design or behavioral segmentation
Exposure to CRM tools or player personalization systems
Knowledge of the Star Trek universe or sci-fi genre games
Work Schedule

During the initial ramp-up period, new hires are also expected to be available for collaboration during daytime hours, approximately between 10:30 AM and 4:30 PM IST, with some flexibility. Candidates should be comfortable working a split schedule during the ramp-up phase, with at least two hours of guaranteed overlap with the U.S. team.

Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue.

Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities
We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

Truecaller's ads business reaches over 400 million users and is one of the largest in-app advertising platforms in its markets.

We are building a modern, server-driven programmatic stack that we own end to end, and this role owns the platform at the heart of it: the intelligence layer that powers demand-supply matching across all our demand channels.

Every ad opportunity flows through this platform, and it decides how that opportunity is valued, priced, auctioned, and allocated to maximize revenue while protecting user experience.
This is a senior, high-ownership role at the center of a multi-year platform build, working closely with engineering, data science, and the supply and demand product teams.

Own the platform strategy and roadmap: the decisioning, auction, and pricing systems that sit between our supply and our demand partners.
Build auction intelligence: bid landscape analysis, pricing and floor strategies, auction design, and demand orchestration that decides which demand sources to invoke for each opportunity.
Drive yield: deliver measurable improvements in eCPM, fill, win rate, and incremental revenue; identify revenue leakage and close it through platform enhancements.
Optimize for scale: drive initiatives around platform performance, reliability, and latency as traffic volumes and demand partners grow.
Shape the long-term architecture: capabilities like traffic shaping, audience-based packaging, and curated marketplaces that turn the platform into a durable competitive advantage.
Run a rigorous operating cadence: define platform KPIs and operational health metrics, design controlled experiments, and iterate based on measured impact.

6+ years in product management, with 3+ years in ad tech, programmatic advertising, or publisher monetization platforms. Hands-on experience driving revenue growth through programmatic is essential.
Programmatic depth: Strong understanding of the ecosystem, including unified auctions, header bidding, open bidding, mediation models, oRTB, and auction dynamics. Working knowledge of platforms such as Google Ad Manager, PubMatic, or ironSource.
Monetization fluency: comfort with the full KPI stack (eCPM, fill rate, match rate, win rate, bid density, viewability, ARPU) and a track record of using it to find and capture yield.
Platform product skills: proven experience building large-scale platform products with engineering-heavy teams, and the ability to translate complex business problems into scalable platform capabilities. Good understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and latency-sensitive architecture.
Data-driven rigor: strong analytical skills, comfort with large datasets, and fluency in experimentation, A/B testing, and controlled rollouts.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.
We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
AI agents are changing how everyone works — not just developers writing code, but entire organizations building, deploying, and operating software. Agents are becoming teammates: they write code, run tests, manage infrastructure, analyze data, and automate workflows across every function.

Docker is building a new platform from scratch to make this real — secure execution environments, agent-to-tool connectivity, governance controls, and the infrastructure that lets agents and humans collaborate safely at enterprise scale.
This is a 0-to-1 role. You will define the product strategy and own the roadmap for a new platform that sits at the intersection of AI, containers, and developer experience. You will work with a small, high-velocity team spanning engineering, design, and go-to-market to figure out what to build, ship it, learn from it, and iterate. The early signal is already in market — Docker Sandboxes is one of the fastest-growing new products in Docker’s history — and the opportunity ahead is much larger.
We are looking for someone who builds, not just plans. You should be comfortable prototyping, getting your hands dirty with early product iterations, and improvising when things don’t go as expected. The right candidate has shipped developer tools or infrastructure products, understands how the agentic AI ecosystem is evolving, and thrives in the ambiguity of building something genuinely new.

Own the product strategy. Define the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for Docker’s AI & Agent Platform. Make hard tradeoff decisions about what to build, what to defer, and what to cut.
Build from zero. This is a new platform. You will define the product from the ground up — writing the first specs, prototyping with engineering, validating with customers, and iterating rapidly based on what you learn.
Drive from conception through delivery. Write requirements, work with engineering to scope and prioritize, ship iteratively, and measure outcomes. You don’t hand off specs and wait — you are in the details.
Define how pieces of the agentic ecosystem fit together. Agents need secure execution, tool connectivity, model access, governance, and observability. You will define how these capabilities compose into a coherent platform — and where Docker’s boundaries are.
Think beyond developers. Agents are becoming essential for everyone who builds, deploys, and operates software. You will ensure the platform serves the full range of people who need agents to succeed — from individual developers to platform teams to enterprise operators.
Define the developer experience. Work with design and engineering to ensure that our AI products are intuitive, powerful, and meet people where they are — whether in the CLI, IDE, or CI pipeline.
Collaborate across Docker. You will work cross-functionally to ensure coherent product experiences and go-to-market alignment.
Influence technical direction. Partner with engineering leadership on architecture decisions. You don’t need to write the code, but you need to understand the technical tradeoffs and have informed opinions about them.
Represent the customer. Engage directly with developers, enterprises, and partners. Bring their voice into every product decision.
Overcome blockers. When something is in the way — a missing integration, an unclear market signal, a technical constraint — you figure out a path forward. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem.

Experience . 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years on developer tools, infrastructure, or platform products.
Deep technical fluency. You can read an architecture diagram, understand container and VM runtimes, and have a working knowledge of how AI agents, LLMs, and protocol-level tool connectivity work. You don’t need to be a hypervisor engineer, but you need to hold your own with one.
Proven ability to ship 0-to-1 products. You have taken a product from idea through launch in a fast-moving environment. You know how to operate when there is no playbook.
Builder mentality. You prototype, you sketch architectures, you test early ideas with customers before the spec is done. You are a doer, not just a thinker.
Strong product sense and UX instincts. You care about the developer experience at a deep level — from API design to CLI ergonomics to error messages.
Strategic thinking with execution follow-through. You can set a multi-year vision and also write the spec for what ships next sprint.
Comfort with ambiguity. This space is new and moving fast. You thrive when the answer isn’t obvious and you have to go find it.
Excellent communication. You can write a crisp product brief, present to executives, and debate technical tradeoffs with engineers — all in the same day.
Experience growing and monetizing products at scale. You have been part of taking a product from early adoption to meaningful revenue, and you understand the pricing, packaging, and go-to-market decisions that make that happen.

Experience building products in the containers, cloud-native, or DevOps space
Experience with AI/ML developer tooling or the agentic AI ecosystem
Contributions to open source projects
Experience building and scaling a business from zero to significant ARR
What You’ll Work With
We are building a new platform for agentic development. Docker Sandboxes — isolated execution environments for AI coding agents — is one of the first products in this platform and one of the fastest-growing new products in Docker’s history. But this is just the beginning. The platform will grow to span multiple product areas as we define how agents and people work together at scale.

s.h: The technologies you will work across include
s.t:
Secure, isolated execution environments (microVMs, containers, sandboxing)
Agent-to-tool connectivity and protocol standards (MCP and beyond)
AI model serving and inference infrastructure
Governance, policy enforcement, and audit controls for enterprise AI adoption
Local-to-cloud execution and workload portability
Developer CLIs, SDKs, and platform APIs

What you'll own
The product roadmap and the reasoning behind it: what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.
The boundary between standard product, configuration, and manual work for one customer.
Requirements that engineering can build from: scope, acceptance criteria, and a clear statement of what is out.
What we can credibly promise a customer, including where the product's limits currently are.
Proofs of Value that you run yourself, and responsibility for individual accounts.
Prototypes you build to test features with customers before we commit engineering time.
How product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.
Your number: how much of what is project work today is standard product a year from now, and the time from a recognised customer problem to a usable capability.
This role is not for you if your strength is backlog, process and ceremonies, if you need research and design capacity before you can decide, if a complex industrial domain is an obstacle rather than the interesting part, if you don't like data or if you need more than three days before your first customer conversation.

A technical and analytical foundation, engineering, data analytics, data science, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling from a technical degree, technical consulting, or technical product management. 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. More important than the title: you have owned a product area end to end before, not only a backlog.
Experience deciding under incomplete information, and the ability to explain your trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
You can sit with a plant manager or a controller, understand how they decide today, and leave the room knowing what the product has to do about it.
Good to have, not a cut off: optimization experience, deeper knowledge in manufacturing, supply chain or S&OP, enterprise B2B sales cycles involving operations, IT and controlling, or early-stage startup experience.
German C1 or higher, fluent in English.
NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Impact. You work with substance and lead what the product becomes.

We build software to enable sustainable agriculture supply chains.
~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator.

Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met.

Enterprise software and new business processes can help - to make processes in the day-to-day more efficient, connect farmers better to their partners and thus, enable action in supply chains.
We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early stage tech team in Europe.
Today Root is the #1 primary data collection platform for dairy in DACH. We are AI-enabled at the core and driving the AI transformation across the food and agri world. The next chapter is bigger.
🔭 What you will work on

Build an innovative operating system for the dairy industry from 0 to 1, at the intersection of farmers and dairies. Dairy is Root's home market. We know it inside out - the players, the workflows, the technology gaps, the people. We see a category-defining opportunity to build a new product line that sits between farmers and dairy processors, and that has the potential to become the connecting piece of our portfolio.
This is a genuinely greenfield role. You will not inherit a backlog. You will define what we build, why, and for whom - then prove it works with a handful of pilot customers before we scale.

s.h: What your job will look like
s.t:
Run deep discovery. Spend weeks with farmers, farm technicians, milk procurement teams, and dairy executives on-site. Understand their jobs, KPIs, and frustrations from the inside.

Build hacky prototypes and run pilots. Show, do not tell. Get something tangible in front of 2-3 design partners within weeks.
Assess desirability, feasibility, and viability before we commit serious engineering investment.
Define the v1 spec with engineering and design once we have conviction. Set the team up for delivery.
Onboard the first paying customers and iterate fast. Own the loop.
Decide what we will NOT build. Scope discipline is critical with limited engineering capacity and a customer base that operates on a fixed annual cycle.
You will work side by side with the Head of Product to make the bet, and own the product line end-to-end as it grows. Engineering and design support will scale with traction.

Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.

The Problem Worth Solving
Generative AI is a powerful reasoning engine — but it operates blind inside enterprise software. It can't map a million-line multi-technologies codebase, trace cross-technology dependencies, or quantify technical debt. When asked to help modernize a legacy application, it guesses.
The industry's answer has been RAG and vector databases. Useful — but approximate. Semantic similarity is not the same as architectural truth.
CAST 's answer: give AI the exact structural blueprint of the application, derived deterministically from source code analysis across 150+ technologies. Not approximations. Actual call graphs, dependency maps, transaction flows — the ground truth of how software actually works. We call this Software Intelligence. We're now building the bridge that puts it directly in the hands of AI agents.

What You'll Be Building

As Technical Product Manager – AI & Agents, you'll own the product definition and roadmap for integrating CAST 's platforms — CAST Imaging and CAST Highlight — into the agentic AI ecosystem. Concretely:
MCP Server & Agentic integrations. CAST Imaging already exposes its structural insights via an MCP server, making any MCP-aware agent — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini — structurally aware of the application it's working on. You'll drive what data gets exposed, how agents consume it, and what new capabilities this unlocks for developers, architects, and transformation teams.
Hyperscaler partnerships . You'll manage and grow technical integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. Our published research with Google has already demonstrated that augmenting Gemini with CAST 's structural analysis produces measurably deeper results on enterprise codebases. You'll be the product owner turning that into a repeatable offering.
GSI co-innovation. Tier-1 global system integrators are at the forefront of industrializing AI in the software development lifecycle — at enterprise scale, across industries. You'll work directly with them to understand where AI-driven modernization breaks down in practice, what's missing, and where CAST intelligence fills the gap. They're one of your best proxies for real market needs, and a source of product ideas you won't find in analyst reports.
Next-generation retrieval. Our research team is actively exploring approaches that go beyond standard RAG — combining deterministic structural graphs with semantic retrieval to give agents richer, more grounded context. You'll translate emerging research into product bets, defining what gets productized and when.

Hands-on background in software engineering or architecture. You can read a call graph, understand what a dependency means in practice, and have opinions about technical debt.
Experience with agentic AI, LLM integrations, or developer tooling — building products or shipping integrations.
Ability to work across research, engineering, and commercial teams — and translate between all three.
Fluent English. Our teams and partners are global.

Why This Role The intersection of software intelligence and AI agents is where the next generation of enterprise software transformation will be decided. You'll work with a research team that publishes with Google Cloud, ships MCP integrations used by real enterprise customers, and is actively pushing the frontier on how AI understands software at scale. The scope is real. The partners are serious. The problem is unsolved. Reporting to : Head of R&D Originally posted on Himalayas

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

Reliability. Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

Corridor and market design . Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

Integration standards. You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. Resilience. Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

The Opportunity

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

Integration delivery against committed dates.

Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

**Was kann ich bewirken?**
Ein grosser Industriekunde wünscht sich eine verbesserte Suche. An einem Workshop holst du gemeinsam mit unserem Team die relevanten Use-Cases ab. Du skizzierst Optionen, welche LLM, Live-Suche und eine intuitive Filterung beinhalten. Später spezifizierst du deren Funktionsweise im Detail, koordinierst die Lösung mit den Entwickelnden und testest sie.
Ein NGO nutzt ein HR-Tool und möchte erfahren, ob und wie dieses in ihre Website eingebunden werden kann. Du zeigst die relevanten technischen Optionen auf mit Vor- und Nachteilen und Konsequenzen.
Mit deiner (noch) unvoreingenommenen Aussenperspektive hinterfragst du unsere aktuellen Kundenprojekte aktiv und faktenbasiert: Was sollten wir optimieren, damit diese das Ziel unserer Kunden und ihrer User noch besser erfüllen?
Kurz: Du denkst und spezifizierst Lösungen, die Menschen nicht nur entlasten, sondern begeistern.
**Who the Hell is Helga?**
Wir stehen am Morgen auf, um die Welt an diesem Tag einen kleinen Schritt effizienter, userfreundlicher und damit besser zu machen. Um am Abend etwas dazugelernt und gemeinsam eine gute Zeit verbracht zu haben.
Das tun wir als 11-köpfige Berner Digitalagentur, indem wir Web-basierte Lösungen entwickeln, welche das digitale Morgen prägen. Indem wir mutig denken. Indem wir als zuverlässiger Partner etwas Konkretes bewirken. Mit höchsten Ansprüchen an User-Experience, Technologie und uns selber.
Mit dem Anspruch, Kunden zu begeistern und ihre User umzuhauen.
**Was erwartet ihr von mir?**
Vor allem: Die Fähigkeit, umwerfende Lösungen zu entwickeln - und logisches Denken. Zudem: Affinität zu Software und Erfahrung mit Product Development und Requirements Engineering.
*Kompetenzen*

s.h: Here-s the catch - du vereinigst zwei Widersprüche
s.t:
* Einerseits Ideation: Du denkst mutig und offen und schnell, bist kreativ und nimmst unerwartete Perspektiven ein. Damit findest und skizzierst du Lösungen, welche das Ordinäre sprengen.
* Andererseits arbeitest du strukturiert, logisch und mit einem Blick fürs Detail. Damit dokumentierst du deine Lösungen so, dass unsere technologiefernen Kunden sie verstehen und unsere Software-Entwickelnden diese umsetzen können.
* Du musst Menschen nicht lieben - aber ausgezeichnet mit ihnen umgehen können, locker und seriös gleichzeitig. Du kannst sie abholen, wo sie gerade sind und dahin führen, wo du sie begeistern kannst.
*Hintergrund*
* Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von (digitalen) Produkten, mit Business Analysis, Product Ownership oder Requirements Engineering.
* Datenmodellierung, Schnittstellendefinitionen, User Story Writing, Spezifikationen und Wireframing sind dein Werkzeugkasten.
* Digitales und sein Potential begeistern dich. Du bringst ein tiefes technologisches Verständnis mit: Was ist ein CMS (und wo gliedert sich da Drupal ein), was heisst serverseitiges Rendering, was ist eine relationale Datenstruktur? Geschenkt.
* Keine Sorge, Französisch ist nicht nötig. Aber: Dein Deutsch ist ausgezeichnet und dein gesprochenes Englisch solide (ja, für alles Schriftliche gibt-s LLMs).
*Charakter*
* Du hast Bock, mit einem motivierten Team zusammen zu wachsen, dieses mitzuprägen und darin Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
* Du brüskierst dich an unklaren Ansagen und wirst ungeduldig bei langwierigen Meetings.
* Du erkennst Herausforderungen und gehst sie aktiv an. Du suchst und siehst Potential, nicht Probleme.
* Du willst nicht nur digitale Lösungen, sondern auch dich weiterentwickeln. Und im besten Fall die Agentur gleich mit.
**Und wieso gerade Helga?**
Du wirst Teil eines 11-köpfigen Teams - bist also keine Nummer, sondern ein Charakter. Wir sind konsensorientiert, arbeiten auf das gleiche Ziel hin und finden die beste Lösung gemeinsam.
Als Unternehmen und Personen entwickeln und bilden wir uns laufend weiter. Du kannst mitreden, deine Arbeit mitgestalten und unsere Zukunft prägen.
**Überzeugt! Wie weiter?**

SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft
Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Mission
KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.
Dein Profil
Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.
KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.
Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein starkes Plus – ebenso Vertrautheit mit Accounting-/Finance-Software-Stacks, DATEV, ELSTER oder regulierten Datenworkflows.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
About Axon
Axon’s mission is simple and bold: Protect Life .
We build technology that helps first responders, security teams, and communities act with speed, clarity, and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security, and international agencies detect, assess, and respond to threats.
Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors, and location data into a unified operating picture, accessible on any device. Alerts and presence are the heartbeat of that picture. They determine what demands attention and who is in position to act. We're building intelligent, high-signal alerting and presence experiences that cut through noise and keep operators and responders locked into what matters most.

As Senior Product Manager for Alerts & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus surfaces the right information to the right people at the right time - making alerts and responder presence the connective tissue of real-time operations.
You'll build the systems that determine what warrants attention, how it's prioritized and routed, and how operators maintain awareness of who is where. This spans alert generation from cameras, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party sources, as well as the presence layer that tracks responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity.
Your work will enable officers, security teams, and emergency responders around the world to cut through noise, act on what matters, and coordinate with confidence. By making alerts smarter and presence data seamless, your work will help prevent harm, accelerate response, and directly advance Axon's mission to Protect Life.
Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency, and reliable alerting and presence features across web and mobile
Engage global law enforcement and enterprise users to validate needs and test improvements
Align with other product teams to ensure alerts and presence data flow seamlessly across the platform
Use metrics and feedback to refine roadmap priorities - reducing alert fatigue, improving time-to-action, and increasing situational awareness
Support go-to-market, training, and rollout with cross-functional teams
What Success Looks Like
Operators and responders receive timely, high-signal alerts that drive faster, more confident decisions
Presence data gives commanders and dispatchers clear visibility into who is where - improving coordination and resource deployment
Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention, and positive field feedback

We’re hiring for a Product Manager to lead our Lending product at Chime. You'll own one of Chime's fastest-growing, highest NPS products and define the future of lending for millions of members—setting strategy, making the key product decisions, and leading the next phase of growth for one of Chime's most important businesses.

This is an opportunity to reimagine how lending works in America by building products that help our members access credit responsibly and make meaningful financial progress.
As our Product Manager, you'll own the product end-to-end—from defining strategy and prioritizing investments to partnering across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance to bring your vision to life. You'll inherit a profitable, high-growth business with significant runway ahead, giving you the opportunity to expand the product, unlock new member value, and shape the future of lending at Chime.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $196,000 and up to $255,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Own the Lending product strategy and roadmap end-to-end, balancing member impact, business growth, and long-term platform investments.
Lead the next chapter of one of Chime's fastest-growing and highest NPS products by expanding the product into new use cases and member experiences.
Reimagine how lending works for everyday Americans by delivering innovative, responsible financial products that help members make meaningful financial progress.
Drive product decisions across the full product lifecycle, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance.
Make high-conviction prioritization decisions and align cross-functional teams around a clear product vision, measurable outcomes, and business impact.
Use customer insights, experimentation, and data to continuously improve the member experience while growing a profitable business.
Serve as the product leader for the team, creating clarity, setting direction, and ensuring exceptional execution from strategy through launch.
To thrive in this role, you have
Significant experience leading consumer product strategy and execution for high-impact digital products from concept through scale.
A proven track record of owning complex product areas with measurable business outcomes, ideally including growth, monetization, or financial products.
Experience building or managing lending, credit, or other consumer financial products is strongly preferred.
Experience making strategic product decisions in highly cross-functional environments with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Risk, and business partners.
Strong product intuition backed by data, with the ability to prioritize effectively and make thoughtful tradeoffs.
Experience building products that simplify complex customer problems and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and executive audiences.

Product Manager Specific Solutions
DECTRIS is a successful and expanding high\-tech company that develops and produces X\-ray and electron detectors. Our detectors are used worldwide in large\-scale research facilities and in industry. Their unique properties enable scientific breakthroughs in life sciences and material sciences.

Our more than 170 employees are located in Switzerland, the United States and Japan. At DECTRIS, we combine innovation and development with agile industry practices. As a spin\-off of the Institute and by focusing on the needs of our customers, we are able to combine scientific excellence with qualified service and industrial know\-how.
Our scientists as well as our technical and commercial experts ensure that our customers benefit from the latest technologies.
DECTRIS values collaborative working rather than traditional hierarchy and is guided by the principles of Sociocracy 3\.0\.
Your Tasks
Proactive Customer Interaction: Systematically track customers' upgrade cycles and facility roadmaps to engage in technical design dialogues pre\-tender, influencing specifications early, and harvesting the full potential of our markets
Strategic Portfolio Balancing: Strategically qualify Specific Solutions projects when standard options are unviable or selectively to demonstrate DECTRIS' cutting\-edge custom capabilities
Strategic Evaluation: Evaluate whether a customer request should be handled as a customized detector or if it signals the need for a new standard product
Requirements Engineering: Coordinate with customers and Area Sales Managers to determine detector requirements, setup details, and application backgrounds
Technical Feasibility: Collaborate with technical experts to estimate feasibility, risks, effort, time, and costs for novel designs
Proposal Management: Provide Sales with technical concepts, price estimations, and lead times to create winning offers
Project Oversight: Maintain a clear overview of ongoing projects and keep all internal and external stakeholders informed
Balancing Interests: Find pragmatic solutions that match the customer's timeline and budget while protecting DECTRIS' interests and technical standards
Visibility and Outreach: Represent Specific Solutions at conferences, user meetings, and facility visits; turn completed custom builds into reference cases and application stories that seed the next generation of requests
Your Skills
Science/engineering degree or similar, previous experience in product management or project management is an asset
Strong understanding of X\-ray technology, vacuum systems, and related equipment. You can quickly grasp the capabilities and boundaries of our standard products
Excellent skills in interacting with various stakeholders, from scientists in international research facilities to internal cross\-functional teams
Ability to identify and reduce technical risks and suggest pragmatic solutions
Understanding of how market trends and customers' needs can be leveraged to enhance business outcomes
You understand where the X\-ray markets, its applications, and customer needs are heading, and you can translate that into which custom requests are worth pursuing
Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer requests simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines
You are precise in creating and updating project and product documentation

A successful and growing high tech company in an international, scientific environment
To join the global leader in HPC X\-ray detectors for science and industry. Our Developers design cutting\-edge detectors to support the state of the art science and technology
An international work environment formed by more than 170 experienced engineers, scientists and other professionals. The company languages are German and English
Excellent, flexible working arrangements to enable professional development and personal life balance
An attractive working environment: modern infrastructure with wheelchair\-accessible rooms, small fitness room, underground car park, subsidised meals, free snacks and drinks, various company events, internal and external training, home office options, after\-work beers and other joint leisure activities
X\-ray Markets Team
The purpose of the X\-ray Markets Team within DECTRIS is to drive DECTRIS' market leadership and competitiveness in the synchrotron and laboratory markets. s.t:
As the Senior Product Manager II for Menu Planning within the Operations Mega Alliance, you will own the product layer that decides what lands on HelloFresh menus every week, across markets, brands, and millions of customers.

You will drive the systems and workflows that let our culinary, commercial, and operations teams plan, version, and scale an ever-expanding menu, working back from their needs to build the automation and data foundations that make a larger and more personalized assortment possible.
This is a domain in the middle of a significant platform transformation: you will help move menu planning into a smarter baseline, all while keeping weekly menu delivery running without disruption. You will partner closely with engineering, culinary, procurement, and stakeholders across our largest markets to define a data-driven roadmap, untangle real complexity around regionality and menu customization, and set the long-term vision for how HelloFresh builds its menu at scale.

Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for menu planning, turning the needs of culinary, commercial, and operations partners into prioritized initiatives tied to clear business impact.
Build scalable systems and data foundations for menu versioning, regionality, and customization that make a larger, more personalized assortment possible.
Leverage AI and machine learning to automate menu and editorial workflows and sharpen assortment decisions, partnering with data science to take models from concept to production.
Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and senior stakeholders across our largest markets to gather requirements, align in direction, and secure buy-in for strategic bets.
Apply a data-driven approach, using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and measure outcomes.
Champion product craft as the hands-on expert for menu planning, raising the bar on discovery, prioritization, and execution across the tribe.

Seasoned product experience building and scaling technical or platform products, ideally in a domain with real operational or supply-chain complexity.
Ability to navigate ambiguity , shaping strategy in undefined problem spaces without waiting for a predefined solution.
Data-driven decision-making , comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and prove impact.
Fluency working alongside engineers, designers and data people , enough to understand technical trade-offs, feasibility, and how AI and machine learning can be applied to real workflows.
Strong communication and stakeholder skills , with a knack for aligning and influencing partners at every level and steering cross-functional teams toward shared goals.
Proven knack for structure , breaking multifaceted problems into parts others can act on.

You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.
Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.
Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity.

This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player.

This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.
You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.
You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.
Strategic Orchestration & Influence
Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.
Team Leadership
Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.
Vendor and Demand Management
Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.
Stakeholder Partnership
Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

Scopely is looking for a Lead Technical Product Manager to join our MONOPOLY GO! team remotely within the US.
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who develop, publish, and innovate some of the world's most beloved interactive entertainment experiences.
MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. Our team spans Europe and the US, working together every day to build innovative technology and unforgettable experiences that delight our players.

As the Lead Technical Product Manager for Live Technology, you will report to the Live Technology Vertical Owner and partner closely with engineering, product, analytics, and operations leaders to define and execute the roadmap for our core live technology systems.
This position bridges platform strategy, data-driven analysis, and execution discipline. As a senior individual contributor, you will link infrastructure, disaster recovery, and studio productivity initiatives to tangible player impact and business growth, ensuring our technical efforts remain focused on high-impact objectives.
You are responsible for driving KPIs across our technology stack, leveraging operational judgment to prioritize workstreams and aligning stakeholders through transparent success metrics and delivery plans.

Partner with technical, product, and production leadership to drive the Live Technology vision. You will:
Partner with the Live Technology Vertical Owner to define and drive the vertical vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap
Translate complex technical, operational, and studio needs into clear product direction and executable plans
Own vertical-level KPIs, success metrics, rollout plans, and investment measurement
Use data, product judgment, and technical fluency to identify high-value opportunities and guide prioritization
Lead product definition across studio productivity, live operations, platform reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery
Prioritize and deliver high-impact platform initiatives in partnership with Engineering, Product, Production, Quality, and Analytics
Connect technical strategy and investment decisions to measurable product, player, and business outcomes
Align stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs, risks, and roadmap decisions through clear, proactive communication
Serve as the bridge between development teams and internal users, ensuring clarity of vision, requirements, and expected impact
Own multiple concurrent workstreams with strong execution discipline and end-to-end accountability
Champion developer productivity, operational excellence, quality, and continuous improvement
Support incident response by enabling clear communication, structured coordination, and post-incident analysis that drives durable improvements

Minimum of 5 years of experience leading technical product management for game development platforms, live technology, or large-scale software systems
A champion of engineering culture and a strong driver of communication between technical domains and product
Strong understanding of technical product management methodologies and tools
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong leadership and team management skills
Strong technical understanding of cloud platforms and modern backend architectures, with the ability to collaborate effectively on scalable, distributed systems. Experience with game engines such as Unity and cloud platforms such as AWS is a plus.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Curious about emerging AI tools and technologies, with a mindset of thoughtfully exploring how they can improve productivity, streamline workflows, and help teams deliver better outcomes.
At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others.

Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami.

Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue.

Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ .
